rows.title: The consent promises no password or code
rows.defect: the no-password sentence is dropped from the consent
rows.test: the consent says Upmore never sees or keeps a password or code

rows.title: Only an explicit yes
rows.defect: any truthy answer counts as consent
rows.test: 'yes', 1 or a missing answer is not consent

rows.title: The exact words are recorded
rows.defect: only the first sentence is recorded
rows.test: the record's text is the whole consent

rows.title: Sign-in on https only
rows.defect: plain http passes the login check
rows.test: an http login page fails

rows.title: Signed-in and signed-out texts
rows.defect: the signed-out check is gone
rows.test: an empty signed_out_when fails

rows.title: Reads only balances and positions
rows.defect: any named field can be read
rows.test: a password or account-number read fails

rows.title: No buy or sell click
rows.defect: buy and sell are missing from the write words
rows.test: Buy and Sell all fail validation

rows.title: No pay, send or cancel click
rows.defect: the write words stop at the original list (the gap this packet found)
rows.test: Pay now, Send money, Cancel plan fail validation

rows.title: Verified names its live run
rows.defect: only a missing verified_on is caught, null passes
rows.test: verified with verified_on null fails

rows.title: Read verbs only
rows.defect: a denylist of order words replaces the allowlist
rows.test: change_setting and delete_account are refused

rows.title: A good check clears failures
rows.defect: a sign-in does not reset the failure count
rows.test: a blip after a good check is still a blip

rows.title: Signed out said once
rows.defect: the sign-out is said on every check
rows.test: the second signed-out check is silent

rows.title: A blip is not broken
rows.defect: one failed load is broken
rows.test: one failed load stays connected

rows.title: No unkept promise when broken
rows.defect: the message promises a follow-up the health job never makes (the bug this packet found)
rows.test: the broken message says the numbers won't update, never 'I'll tell you'

rows.title: Disconnected stays disconnected
rows.defect: the revoked check is gone
rows.test: a signed-in check on a revoked session changes nothing

rows.title: Only connected is polled
rows.defect: every session but a revoked one is polled
rows.test: needs_login, broken and revoked are not due

rows.title: Over a day old is said
rows.defect: stale means a week
rows.test: 25 hours since the last check says so

rows.title: Secret keys dropped however deep
rows.defect: only top-level keys are checked
rows.test: a password three levels down is gone

rows.title: Cookie strings masked anywhere
rows.defect: a cookie pair is masked only at the start of a string or after ';' (the gap this packet found)
rows.test: Cookie: sid=..., set-cookie and ?token= are masked

rows.title: Short secret key names
rows.defect: the key list stops at the long names (the gap this packet found)
rows.test: credential, pin, mfa, 2fa, totp, pwd, jwt, sid are dropped
